permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends decoded Chirp codes to the Chirp server and receives the card to show. Audio is sent only for a voice note, while you hold the touchpad.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens for short Chirp tones from nearby phones, laptops and speakers. Chirp audio is decoded in memory and dropped. Only while you hold the touchpad to record a voice note is that clip sent for transcription.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Optional: listens for Chirp tones through the phone microphone when the user picks phone listening. Chirp audio is decoded in memory and dropped; a voice note you hold to record is sent for transcription.
